texts.orig: quarterly review call between Northwind Analytics and Riverbank Logistics on the 20th of October, 2026. The hosting fee stays at 1200 euros a month. Support moves to a fixed fee of 450 euros a month, built in arrears. Either party may end the agreement with 90 days written notice.
